en: Full moon's tomorrow! Let's save Monkey-face and the rest! First, Taiyi on Mount Qianyuan!
Welcome to Chentang Pass!
Chentang Pass has two divine artifacts!
N-Nezha?! You're... not dead!
Lord Li Jing lives right in there!
Nezha always made his parents mad as a kid. A real brat...
Sorry for being such a bad kid.
N-Nezha?! Don't kill me! Don't kill me!
Hey...
What were you like before, anyway?
Don't kill me! Don't kill me!
So many demons out there~
Why are there so many demons lately?
It's so hot!
Li Jing's son Nezha was carried for three and a half years! A freak!
My wife's pregnant too. Hope she doesn't have a ball of meat...
Oh, quit worrying!
There are hidden summon beasts out there. You need to meet certain conditions to get them!
Nezha's a little rascal, but I know deep down he's a good boy!
I hate Nezha! He's always picking on me...
Li Jing has two other kids, Jinzha and Muzha. They're nothing like Nezha at all. How did Lord Li Jing manage that...
This is the Li manor. What's your business?
Good work! I'm home!
Y-Young master? But you... you were...
Please forgive my rudeness just now...
Let's go in, Miss Yang Jian...
Mm!
The lady's gravely ill, resting in her room...
Since young master Nezha passed, the lady's been bedridden. The master tried every famous doctor, but nothing helped...
Y-Young master...?! Aaah! A ghost!!
Your screaming's scarier than any ghost!
The master's off seeking doctors again...
Since the young master died, the master hasn't smiled in ages...
The Cosmic Bow and Heaven-Shaking Arrow are here. Wait a bit, Miss Yang Jian. I'll go see my mother first...
Go on, Brother Nezha! I'll wait...
Nezha... my child... *sob*...
Mother~ Your unworthy son has come home...
Nezha... my child...
Mother~ I'm back! I'm not dead...
My child... you're really alive! I'm not dreaming? Come here, let me touch you...
Mother...
You're... you're warm... you're really alive... really alive... *sob sob*... Thank goodness... Husband! Come quick!
Father's out fetching a doctor! Mother~ I have something to do. I must go!
Leaving? Won't you wait for your father?
My brothers are in trouble... I have to go! I'll be back before long... Goodbye, Mother~
I understand! Be careful out there!
I will!
Did you see your mother?
Yeah... sorry for the wait! Let's grab the Cosmic Bow and Heaven-Shaking Arrow. The full moon's almost here!
Mm!
Right! With these two, that hag's Celestial Feather Robe won't scare us!
Let's hurry back to Jushan Manor!
What rat dares steal my pass's treasures?!
Father...
N-Nezha, you're alive... thank heavens...
...Ahem! Ungrateful boy! Why are you back? And why do you have the Bow and Arrow?!
I need them to save my brothers at Jushan Manor...
Give them back!
Ungrateful boy! These artifacts date back to the Yellow Emperor's defeat of Chiyou! They guard Chentang Pass! How could I let you take them?
They're ancient divine artifacts! What's wrong with using them to save lives?
No! My duty is to guard these artifacts! Even my own son can't take them!
Then forgive me, Father! Forgive your unworthy son!
Then kill me! Or you'll never take these artifacts...
Father...
Nezha, what are you doing?
M-Master! What are you doing here?
If I hadn't come, you'd be causing another disaster...
B-But...
I understand your duty to guard the artifacts, Lord Li. But using them for a good cause would be a virtuous deed in itself. Do you not agree?
...Your words have opened my eyes, Taiyi. With a master like you, I can rest easy about my boy...
Father... please forgive my rudeness just now...
Nezha, you've grown up... I won't blame you... You're my son, after all... And hey, you've gotten stronger!
Ha ha ha~ Come here, Nezha! I've got some goodies for you...
Thank you, Master...
Nezha got the Cosmic Bow, Heaven-Shaking Arrow, Fire Dragon Millet, Fire-Tipped Spear and Nine-Dragon Fire Cover!
Eat the dragon millet! It'll boost your power greatly...
Yes!
Whoa~ Aah~ Ooh~
I feel power surging through my whole body...
Wow~ Amazing!
Off you go! There's a long road ahead!
Right! I'm off, Master, Father...
...Take care, son!
Let's go, Miss Yang Jian!
Mm!
Say whatever's on your mind, Miss Yang Jian...
Can I... can I call you big brother?
Huh?
Ever since I was little, I always wanted a big brother like you...
...Tell you what! If you don't mind, Miss Yang Jian, let's be sworn siblings!
R-Really?
Little sister~ To Jushan Village!
Mm! Brother Nezha~ Let's go!
The full moon's almost here...
Never thought we'd die far from home...
No! I don't want to die here!
Chanyu... I'm sorry... I, Tu Xingsun, failed to protect you...
Don't say that, dear. It's not your fault...
Chanyu...
Hey hey hey! Don't go off into your own little world!
Ha ha ha~ Any last words? Better say them now!
Hmph! That witch Yang Jian ran off and ditched us! If I die here tonight, I'll come back as a ghost and haunt her forever! She'll never get a moment's peace!
Who are you talking to? Harpy~
Huh...?
Miss Yang Jian! You came back to save us...
Relax! Once I flatten this old hag Shiji, I'll untie you!
Ho ho ho... I think you forgot about my Celestial Feather Robe! Beat me? Ho ho ho...
Ready?
Right! Get back, little sister Yang Jian!
Ugh... th-this is... the Heaven-Shaking... Arrow?
Now, little sister Yang Jian!
You got it!
Ugh... Grand... Tutor... forgive me... Shiji goes first...
Nezha! It's you!
Ho ho ho... The one and only~ It's really me, brother!
But... weren't you...?
I owe it all to my master. He caught my spirit in the Spirit Pearl, then spent 49 days forging me a new body from lotus flowers. That's how I came back!
So that's it! That's awesome! We can travel together again!
Yeah!
So glad you're alive! When you killed yourself, you scared us to death...
You look lively too, Beakface!
Hmph! Not one nice word when we meet...
We owe our rescue to Miss Yang Jian's cleverness...
Oh please... Just now someone said she'd haunt me even after death...
Hmph!
Chanyu was just panicking, Miss Yang Jian~ Please don't take it to heart.
Well~ Since brother Tu Xingsun asks so nicely... fine! I'll be the bigger person and let the harpy off!
Oh, SO generous of you!
What? The harpy doesn't seem grateful!
Okay! Enough bickering! We've got work to do!
Oh right! On the way to Zhaoge we'll pass several gates, the first being Sanshan Pass, which my father guards. I'll convince him to let us through!
Now that's good news!
Wow, the harpy finally made sense.
Why you...
Brother~ Let's go!
Yeah! Next stop, Sanshan Pass!
Thanks a lot~ you nutcase.
...You're welcome~
Let me go! Do you know who my father is? If you dare lay a finger on me, he won't let you off! Let me go! You hear me?!
Mm~ Not bad at all!
Ho ho ho! Told you so!
Mm~ I like 'em feisty. Send her to my room! She's mine!
Big bro~ No way! You got the last one, and the one before that! It's our turn!
I'm the big bro, so what I say goes!
I object!
Me too!
How about this! Let the girl choose!
Good idea~ Let's do that, big bro!
I get it! We'll ask the beauty who she wants to marry!
Missy~ Whose bride will you be? You decide!
None of you! You four freaks, stay away from me!
Asking was me being polite! Since you're so rude... big bro decides! Each of us gets one night. She belongs to all of us. Fair, right?
Great idea!
Big bro's so wise!
So whose turn is tonight?
Big bro's, of course!
Why big bro again?
I object!
I object too!
Shut it! I'm the big bro, what I say goes!
Somebody, help me~
Chanyu, are you okay? I'll save you right now!
Ugly...? You're hurt?
Forget about me! I'm coming to save you...
Ho ho ho... Save her? Look whose turf you're on! You think you can run wild here?
Out of my way!
D-Damn it...
If I... can't have her... neither... will you...
Look out~ Ugly...!
Heh... heh heh... At least... I'll have company... on the road to hell...
Got the Phoenix Pearl.
Tu Xingsun...
That 'ugly' guy you always insult just risked his life to save you! If you've got any heart at all... go see him...
Ch-Chanyu... you're safe... th-that's great...
D-Don't talk... I... I'm so ashamed...
Ch-Chanyu... is this okay? Don't you always... say... I'm a jinx reborn... and should stay... a meter away...? Ch-Chanyu, get back... or my bad luck... will rub off...
I didn't mean any of that! I'll never leave you! Didn't you want me as your wife? So... so please! Don't die! Tu Xingsun~ *sob sob*...
That's... the first time... you called me... Tu Xingsun... I'm going... Chan...yu... take... care...
Tu~ Xing~ sun~!
Okay, okay! Soap opera's over. Tu Xingsun just fainted from fright. That blow never even hit him!
Wh-What did you say?
Want to thank someone? Thank Monkey-face. He's the one who saved Tu Xingsun...
Ha, you noticed!
Ho ho~ If not for this, she'd never have realized she's loved Tu Xingsun all along!
You you you you you...! You witch!
What? Harpy!
Ha ha ha...
Okay, Tu Xingsun needs rest! Let's head back to Jiulong Town!
Ugh...
You're awake! Tu Xingsun...
I... I'm not dead?
Chanyu...
What is it?
I'll give you my bad luck. I'll move a meter away right now...
Don't say that... I only said it to annoy you. You're my husband now. Don't be such a stranger...
H-Husband? You... you mean... Chanyu, you... you'll really marry me? Th-This isn't a dream...?
Only now do I see how good you've been to me. I hope you can forget the past.
Of course! Oh, and Chanyu~ To repay young Pingyan, I've decided to follow and serve him for a while... You go back to your father first...
Look, Tu Xingsun~ I never took that promise seriously! You just got married, stay with Chanyu! And Chanyu, weren't you ordered by King Zhou to arrest us?
... You two saved my husband and me. I can't do that... A wife follows her husband. If he's joining your adventure, so am I!
Ooh~ Did I hear right? The harpy said something human! Not trying to lower our guard so you can nab us all for a reward in Zhaoge? Or are you scared I'll steal your hubby?
Hmph! As if! You? My husband wouldn't even look at you!
Brother Tu Xingsun~ You don't hate little me, do you~?
Huh? ...Wh-Why would I...?
Tu Xingsun!! A few sweet words and she's got you wrapped up!
H-How could I? I...
Ha ha ha~ Knock it off, you two! Time to move!
What?! The Four Demon Men were wiped out?
Your Excellency, every word I speak is true!
...I see! You're dismissed!
Yes!
Lady Shiji!
What are your orders, Excellency?
Avenge your fellow Jin'ao Islanders, the Four Demon Men, for me. Any objection?
Thank you, Excellency. I leave at once!
Ho ho ho... Ruthless! Sending a Jin'ao master after your own childhood friend...
Is that any way to talk to me, Shen Gongbao~? Don't forget, only I can lift the curse on you...
F-Forgive me... I forgot my place. I'll be more careful!
Hmph! You'd better!
Brat! I absorbed this era's Shen Gongbao and became complete, and I lose to a kid like you?! Remember this! Let's see how long you gloat!
Wh-What nonsense are you spouting?!

I believe you know it yourself, Excellency. You have royal Yin blood, and the people's love that King Zhou lacks! Get rid of him, and you'll rule the Shang AND rightfully have Lady Daji... Isn't that so...
Silence! Not another word! Leave!
Do think it over! I'll take my leave!
...Daji...
Yin Wen...
Can I help you, miss?
Excuse me, is Taiyi here?
Master has gone wandering. He's not at the cave. What do you need, miss?
What do I do now... The full moon is tomorrow. Without the Cosmic Bow and Heaven-Shaking Arrow, Monkey-face and Leizhenzi will...
Monkey-face? Leizhenzi? You mean that idiot who's half man, half crow?
You know Leizhenzi?
Then this Monkey-face of yours~ wouldn't be Ji Pingyan, would it?
That's right! Who are you? You know that stinky monkey too?
I'm Nezha, Ji Pingyan's buddy.
Nezha?! Monkey-face told me about you, but aren't you dead? Are you a ghost?!
Long story, miss! Did you say my brother's in trouble?
Mm~ It's Lady Shiji of Jin'ao Island~ That old hag plans to eat them on the full moon to boost her power!
Th-That's terrible!
The hag wears a Celestial Feather Robe, so I came to borrow the Bow and Arrow, but Taiyi's away...
Forget it! That old hag Shiji can't be that tough! I'll save Ji Pingyan now! Where are they?
At Jushan Manor... but...
But we should wait for Taiyi to... Ah! He's already gone...
Ugh... So that Celestial Feather Robe really is... weapon-proof...
Like I said, without the Bow and Arrow, you can't hurt that hag...
Got it! Come with me to Chentang Pass!
Wh-Where? Chentang Pass?
You wanted the Bow and Arrow, right? My father, Li Jing, guards them at Chentang Pass.
That's great! Let's go!
Yeah!
Rest easy, my lord! All goes according to plan...
Ho ho ho... Good... very good...
Ha ha ha ha...
P-Preceptor! Do you mean to rebel?!
Ho ho ho... Rebel? The new wave pushes out the old. You're old... go in peace!
Ugh... My... empire...
Preceptor, you...?
I did all this for you... Lady Daji.
... Your Majesty, your humble servant greets you.
My lady! Please, rise!
Whatever Your Majesty does, I'll help you fully. Now that you've taken the throne, first pull out the roots: King Zhou's sons, Yin Hong and Yin Jiao!
I understand! Guards!
Spread the word! Princes Yin Hong and Yin Jiao killed their father to seize the throne! Arrest them!
At once!
Very wise! And since the brothers take the blame, you shouldn't rush to the throne. To silence gossip, serve as regent for now, and found your own dynasty when the time is right!
Well said, my lady! Brilliant!
You flatter me, Majesty!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Wh-What? Father was... by the Grand Tutor...
...pushed off the Star-Plucking Tower? And we're framed?
Yes! The Preceptor and Lady Daji have ordered your arrest! Please flee, princes!
Princes! By order of the Preceptor and Lady Daji, you're under arrest!
Please don't make this hard for us...
Princes! I'll hold them here! Run!
Understood!
Take care, Changsheng...
What?! The princes escaped?!
Forgive us! Commander Meng Changsheng got in our way...
Guards!
Behead these two! Commander Meng Changsheng dies by a thousand cuts!
Yes!
Mercy, Preceptor...
Grand Tutor Wen! You killed the king, seized the throne, and framed the princes! May you die cursed! Princes... farewell!

Hear me, all! Since the princes' plot, King Zhou has passed. The nation can't go a day without a ruler, so I, Queen Daji, declare: from today, Preceptor Wen Zhong will rule as regent until a new king is crowned. You will all obey him! Together we begin a new Shang! Understood?
We shall remember~
We'll remember your words, my lady.
We will do our utmost!
Long live the Regent and Queen!
Ha ha ha ha ha!
Then I leave Yin Hong and Yin Jiao to you, Hu Ximei~
Rest easy, Regent! Hu Ximei won't let you down! I must avenge my Jin'ao Island sister, Lady Shiji! I'm off!
My lady...
Got summon beast: Forbidden Beast!
How can I help?
20 silver a night.
20 silver a night.
By the king's order, anyone passing without a court pass... is beheaded!
How dare you! Forgot who I am?
F-Forgive me... I didn't see it was you, miss...
I don't need a pass, do I?
No, miss! Please, go in!
They say King Zhou's dead! Killed by Princes Yin Hong and Yin Jiao!
The princes plotting a coup? Luckily Grand Tutor Wen and the Queen saw through it and ordered their arrest!
Grand Tutor Wen... no, the Regent is so wise and mighty!
They say plain-looking Tu Xingsun risked his life to save the young lady, and that's how he won her heart...
Welcome to Sanshan Pass!
Sanshan Pass is guarded by Lord Deng Jiugong!
Deng Jiugong is a peerless fighter, one of King Zhou's best generals!
From Sanshan Pass: northwest is Mount Qilin, north is a Trial Cave, and east is Peach Blossom Village, famous for peaches!
Mount Qilin has a Fire Qilin Cave. They say there's a secret treasure inside!
There's a hidden summon beast in the Trial Cave. Don't miss it!
Big brother~
Meng Yuxuan's brother Changsheng was Zhaoge's commander. Yuxuan idolized him. But he helped the princes kill King Zhou... He's been executed, and Yuxuan took it hard...
I don't believe Changsheng would do that...
Changsheng... why... did you leave me alone...
Cruel fate~ My girl and Changsheng were to wed this spring, and now... sigh~
Thanks for keeping watch!
Oh! Miss, you're back. Come in!
The general's in the hall...
Days ago a weird Taoist called Yuyi Sage came from Zhaoge. What does he want with the general?
Miss, you're back!
The princes pushed King Zhou off a tower? Wow...
That Yuyi Sage looks so creepy!
Welcome back, miss.
Father~ I'm home.
My good girl, you're back! Ho ho ho... and behind you, the Xiqi rebels!
My good girl! What a great service to your father! Ha ha ha, wonderful... wonderful...
Father~ Calm down and hear me out first...
Ha ha ha~ Go on, go on...
Wh-What?! You want me to side with Xiqi and let these rebels through Sanshan Pass?! Did I hear that right?!

You heard right! Please, Father. If they hadn't saved me, I'd never have seen you again. Xiqi has the people's hearts, and Lord Ji Chang is kind to all, unlike cruel King Zhou. We should follow Heaven's will...
...Chanyu... I understand...
Father! Thank you...
Guards~
The lady's unwell. Take her to her room to rest...
Yes!
What are you doing?! Let go of me!
Don't make this hard for us, miss...
Take her away...
Yes!
Father... what are you doing?!

Child, news just came from Zhaoge. King Zhou is dead, slain by the princes in league with the Xiqi traitor Ji Chang! I have orders from Regent Wen Zhong and Lady Daji to seize Yin Hong and Yin Jiao and crush the Xiqi rebels. And you'd have me side with Xiqi and become a traitor?!
King Zhou... no... impossible...
Hey, old man! Don't slander us! My father is upright! However King Zhou pushed him, he never turned! We begged him to overthrow Zhou and he refused! He'd never stoop to assassination!
King Zhou's dead?! Regent Wen Zhong? Could it be... Yin Wen...?
I bet it's Yin Wen's trap to catch us all in one go!
But...
Deng Jiugong! So you're set on standing in our way?
You know full well! Yuyi Sage, if you please...
Brats! You keep killing my Jin'ao brethren. To restore Jin'ao Island's honor... bad luck for you, meeting me, Yuyi Sage!
Hmph! Talk big after you pull it off!
Careful, brother!
Right back at ya!
Sorry, harpy's dad!
Ugh... Yuyi Sage's treasure is too strong! At this rate we'll all die here...
My turn! Nine-Dragon Fire Cover!
Now! Retreat!
Right!
Hmph! Damn it! That Jin'ao Island jerk has some crazy-strong treasure...
Hey! Anyone know what Yuyi Sage's treasure is?
It's a Jin'ao Island treasure called the Hunyuan Umbrella. You've all seen how scary it is, so no need to explain...
Hunyuan Umbrella?
Yeah, my master said the Hunyuan Umbrella is an ancient artifact. No ordinary treasure can match it...
What IS Jin'ao Island, anyway?! Why do they keep hassling us?

Jin'ao Island is where the Jie Sect trains. Their leader and our Chan Sect leader are fellow disciples. We used to keep apart, but lately there's friction, just small clashes. Now they're coming at us hard. I think it's because...
Because of what?
Your good friend, Wen Zhong.
Wen Zhong? You mean Yin Wen?
Yes. Wen Zhong is a high immortal of Jin'ao Island. The Jie Sect is proud he's Preceptor. So opposing him means opposing the Jie Sect.
Kidney Stone Sect, Gold Crow Island, who cares? Bring it on! But... that guy's treasure is kinda strong...
No way to beat the Hunyuan Umbrella?
Well, there IS a way...
Nutcase, quit teasing us! Spit it out!
Nope!
Why you...
What?!
Please tell us, Miss Yang Jian. I'm so worried about Chanyu...
Fine, for brother Tu Xingsun's sake! My master once said only the ancient Vermilion Bird Sword can match the Hunyuan Umbrella. They say it's hidden in the Fire Qilin Cave on Mount Qilin...
Brother, let's hurry west to Mount Qilin!
Got it! Let's go!
I am Jade Qilin, guardian of the Fire Qilin Cave. Who trespasses on sacred ground? Leave, or face my wrath!
Sorry, we need that sword!
Ugh... Is this power even human?
What the...
What's this? The Phoenix Pearl resonates with the Vermilion Bird Sword... they've merged... Legend says the sword works only for a Star General. Has it chosen you? Could you be...
What are you talking about?
Let Jade Qilin lend you its strength...
Why the sudden change of heart? I don't get what you're saying, but more power means more hope... so, I'm counting on you...
Yes! Master!
Got a summon beast: Jade Qilin!
Got Phoenix Pearl and Rusty Vermilion Sword!
Ho ho ho... Give up! You've nowhere left to run... You brothers should feel lucky to die by Hu Ximei's hand, ho ho ho...
Ugh... Damn it... Is this the end?
Big brother...
Die!
Stop!
Who are you? Butting into Mama's business?
Mama...? Hey, nutcase! Is that your long-lost sister?
Monkey-face, you tired of living?
This is Ji Pingyan, heir of the Western Marquis, and party! Here to right wrongs! Witch! How dare you!
Ji Pingyan and party?! What, the rest of us don't have names?!
Ooh~ The rebel Ji Pingyan and party! A pleasure! Every head on Grand Tutor Wen's bounty, all here! Ho ho ho, how lucky!
Let them go! Or don't blame me for what happens!
Ho ho... Change of plans! I'll kill you first, then the brothers.
Ugh... Th-The Vermilion Bird Sword? Brat... I'll remember this...
What was that sword aura...? Whatever, saving them comes first.
Are you two okay?
You okay? I said...
Are you mute?! Is that how you treat the guys who saved you?!
Beakface! Calm down. Anyone who sees that face of yours would be scared stiff!
Hee hee... So true. Let me handle this!
Miss Yang Jian...
There now, you're safe. Can you tell this sweet, gentle big sister who you are? And why that weird old hag was after you?
I said...
You two clueless idiots, you looking down on me?! Want me to finish the job that hag started, right here and now?! Huff... huff...
Sooo gentle, big sister! Hee hee hee...
